circuit_adaptations: USB inlet/independent CC termination and FT232HL support/optional 93AA56 EEPROM circuit adapted from SummerCart64.
FT232H is used in host-selected MPSSE JTAG mode; upstream FT1248 EEPROM template and MCU-primer dependency are not copied. U106 is DNP by default.
SummerCart64 powered oscillator replaced by Abracon ABM3B 12 MHz crystal plus provisional 11 pF C0G load capacitors; physical startup/frequency verification pending.
Added USBLC6-2SC6 data and CC ESD arrays; these are new components, absent from the inspected SC64 USB inlet.
Added separate AP2112K-3.3 USB bridge supply; SC64 host/USB power multiplexer not copied. USB power and host rails remain separate with common ground.
Added SN74AXC4T774PW direction-controlled JTAG translation, ACBUS6-controlled active-low OE with 10k pull-up, target-side service header, damping and target-side bias resistors.
Changed FT232H EECLK/EECS electrical types to outputs in both the local library and embedded child-sheet symbol.
excluded: No manufacturer 3D CAD or Tigard circuit/library file is included by this USB reuse package. Original source downloads and existing cartridge footprints were not modified.
